sentences.en: By and by, the bitter north wind began to blow.
sentences.zh: 渐渐地，刺骨的北风开始刮起。

sentences.en: It is said that the taste of love is bitter.
sentences.zh: 据说爱情的味道是苦涩的。

sentences.en: She has only bitter memories of her time with them.
sentences.zh: 她与他们在一起时的记忆只有痛苦。

senses.zh: 苦的，痛苦的，剧烈的，严寒的
